decision_lens: Prioritizes correctness of fix aggregation and flag deduplication — double-applied fixes or 40x-surfaced flags are product defects.
focus: How LayerStack and LayerApplicationResult flow through chunked processing — scoping, serialization, and aggregation
name: fd-rule-layer-chunking-integration
persona: A backend engineer specializing in data pipeline correctness. Traces how structured objects flow through the system and what breaks when multiplied across 40 chunks.
review_areas: Whether LayerStack config is serialized once and broadcast identically to all chunks
How layerResults.fixes and flagged arrays are aggregated across chunks — deduplication needed?
How unknownLayers is handled at manuscript scale — surface once or 40 times?
Whether Vale detection-only mode duplicates issues at chunk boundaries
How LayerStackEditor communicates config to the chunking dispatcher
Whether per-chunk layerResults are stored individually or only aggregated

Rule layer config for chunk 1 is provably identical to chunk 40
Chunk boundary splits don't cause duplicate flags
